title: The Still Swimming Pool
premise_public: A lifeguard ordered everyone out of an indoor swimming pool. There was no visible accident, but the water was unusually calm.
solution_summary: The circulation pump had stopped. The missing flow and surface ripples told the lifeguard that the filtration system was not running correctly, so swimmers were evacuated as a safety precaution.

facts.text: Return jets normally create visible ripples.
Still water showed the circulation equipment was not operating.
The lifeguard cleared the pool for water-quality safety.

acceptable_solutions: The filtration pump failed, and the lifeguard noticed the still surface.
The pool's circulation had stopped, so the lifeguard told everyone to leave.
The lifeguard saw the pump was off from the lack of ripples.
hints: The concern was not an injured swimmer.
What usually makes ripples even when nobody moves?
